description: DX_DFIR detections stream: for Suricata EVE records @timestamp = the record's timestamp (Filebeat's read time moves to event.ingested), event.dataset = event_type, event.provider = suricata; YARA and Hayabusa records only get event.provider/dataset. Native fields are left untouched.

script.description: event.provider / event.dataset from the tool directory and event_type
script.source: def p = ctx.log?.file?.path; String tool = null; if (p instanceof String) { if (p.contains('/suricata/')) { tool = 'suricata'; } else if (p.contains('/hayabusa/')) { tool = 'hayabusa'; } else if (p.contains('/yara/')) { tool = 'yara'; } } if (tool == null && ctx.event_type != null) { tool = 'suricata'; } if (tool != null) { if (ctx.event == null) { ctx.event = new HashMap(); } if (ctx.event.provider == null) { ctx.event.provider = tool; } if (ctx.event.dataset == null) { if (tool == 'suricata') { ctx.event.dataset = ctx.event_type != null ? ctx.event_type.toString() : 'suricata'; if (p instanceof String && p.endsWith('/suricata.jsonl')) { ctx.event.dataset = 'suricata_index'; } } else { ctx.event.dataset = tool; } } if (tool == 'suricata' && ctx.event.kind == null && 'alert'.equals(ctx.event_type)) { ctx.event.kind = 'alert'; } }
